ecom.product_page.what: A hand-poured soy candle with lavender and a little cedar, in an 8 oz amber jar.
ecom.product_page.details:
8 oz amber glass jar with a black metal lid
100% soy wax and a cotton wick
Scented with lavender and cedarwood oils
Poured by hand in small batches in Asheville
About 45 hours of burn time
